# Streaming profile evidence

2026-10-31, Redis Software 8.6.2, verified 4x QPF; Go 1.27.2, local arm64.
See [method and limitations](plan.md#streaming-measurements). Three trials per condition.
Times are instrumented milliseconds; memory is decimal MB. Sampled heap is a
process-level observation with retained consumer batches, not peak RSS.

The samples do not establish a consistent timing/allocation improvement.
Prepared-key lists and parsing remain input-sized, and client retention
contributes to the observed heap. The strict streaming policy rejects blocking
fallback; it does not turn these observations into a whole-process memory cap.
